categories.name: Stakeholder / Mission
categories.plain: What customers and the mission need

elements.name: Vehicle Acceleration Performance
elements.text: The vehicle shall accelerate from 0-60 mph in under 6 seconds.
elements.rationale: Customer expectation for a sporty electric vehicle.
elements.acceptance: Measured on a closed track with a fully charged battery.

elements.name: Propulsion Delivery
elements.text: The system shall deliver propulsive torque to the drive wheels on driver demand.

elements.name: Energy Storage Capacity
elements.text: The system shall store sufficient energy for a 300 mile range.
elements.rationale: Range is a top-level customer promise.
elements.acceptance: EPA range test cycle result >= 300 miles.

elements.name: Motor Torque Output
elements.text: The powertrain shall produce at least 400 N*m of peak torque.
elements.rationale: Sized to meet the acceleration requirement.

elements.name: Powertrain Efficiency
elements.text: The powertrain shall convert at least 90% of input electrical energy to mechanical work.
elements.acceptance: Bench efficiency mapping across the drive cycle.

elements.name: ElectricVehicle
elements.label: Whole vehicle
elements.blurb: The car as a whole. Top-level promises to the customer live here.

elements.name: PowertrainSystem
elements.label: Powertrain
elements.blurb: Electric motors, reduction gears and half-shafts that turn electricity into motion.

elements.name: EnergyStorageSystem
elements.label: Battery pack
elements.blurb: The skateboard battery under the floor. Stores the energy for range and acceleration.
